about: Strings for Silent Night's Kiểu 1 (version 1), written by Composer's Assistant 2 hearing the upright (its tune an octave up, its pulse and deep bass), laid out as Jingle Bells' Kiểu 1 strings were in 3a, the version the user chose: a bed from the first verse to the last chord (bars 0-72, three verses), the violas (two notes at a time at most) and the cellos (one) throughout, the violins (one) in the last verse, each under the tune (loosely: lay_in keeps what the model wrote); in place of pulse's own strings there.
